whbar.$comment: WHBAR contract (token 0.0.1456986, 8 decimals): its HBAR backs wrapped HBAR in SaucerSwap and other DEX pools. Owner decision 2026-11-08: DEX/wrapped, no look-through to WHBAR holders.

waivers.staker-balances: HBAR has no staking contract: network staking is protocol-level and shown as an informational tile (mirror /network/stake, owner decision 2026-11-08), never subtracted from holders.
waivers.history-gaps: fill-history-gaps.js only repairs EVM block-timestamp gaps; HBAR history is forward-only from its first settled snapshot (owner decision 2026-11-11).
waivers.cex-candidates: detect-cex-candidates.js scans an EVM transfer graph only; HBAR exchange accounts come from proof-of-reserves and reviewed lists (scripts/lib/hedera/cexAccounts.js).
